CONTRACTS.EFFECTIVE_SPECIFICATION: Only ISSUE32 is normative. Past approvals remain in Git history.

ISSUE32_CONTRACTS_REVISION.SCOPE: Proposed target-module constraints only. Existing approved Issue #25 and legacy module/function contracts remain historically intact; this block does not authorize implementation or imply that unspecified function signatures have been approved.

MODULE_CONTRACT.RESPONSIBILITY: Route all conversation operations through /conversations and descendants using the existing conversation domain code.
MODULE_CONTRACT.NON_RESPONSIBILITIES: Do not provide target /v1 or /v2 aliases; do not duplicate handlers.
MODULE_CONTRACT.PRECONDITIONS: Approved unversioned /conversations operation map and DPoP authorization boundary.
MODULE_CONTRACT.POSTCONDITIONS: Exactly one target conversation API tree; no accidental new public endpoints.

MODULE_CONTRACT.RESPONSIBILITY: Accept validated session-bound DPoP only through the existing UDS security boundary, then independently enforce membership/role per protected operation and WS subscription.
MODULE_CONTRACT.FORBIDDEN: Plain Bearer fallback; trusting client identity/membership assertions; unauthorized live publication.
MODULE_CONTRACT.FAILURE_BEHAVIOR: Deny and log sanitized structured authentication/authorization failure; no writes or data disclosure.

MODULE_CONTRACT.RESPONSIBILITY: Preserve existing /v2 direct/group behavior, ordering, idempotency, membership intervals, documents, realtime and read state without reimplementation.
MODULE_CONTRACT.FORBIDDEN: Deleting history or inferring Drive document permissions from chat membership.

MODULE_CONTRACT.RESPONSIBILITY: Identify obsolete legacy storage definitions and routes using only repository source; propose safe deletion boundaries without production-data inspection, migration or data writes.
MODULE_CONTRACT.PRECONDITIONS: Approved upstream GRACE artifacts and verified repository-source ownership of obsolete definitions; no assumptions about production data.
MODULE_CONTRACT.FAILURE_BEHAVIOR: Stop if removal threatens any working direct/group functionality or authorization; never execute destructive database operations.
MODULE_CONTRACT.FORBIDDEN: Production DB changes, data migrations, production-data inspection, old-client compatibility work and silent destructive operations.

MODULE_CONTRACT.RESPONSIBILITY: One direct UUID pair, group, roles and membership windows.
MODULE_CONTRACT.INVARIANT: Concurrent direct creation unique; owner transfer authorized; no history outside membership windows.

MODULE_CONTRACT.RESPONSIBILITY: Order, cursor-visible history, idempotency, size limits, document metadata and read state.
MODULE_CONTRACT.INVARIANT: Never grant file rights; duplicate sends create no new messages; conflicting payload returns 409.

MODULE_CONTRACT.RESPONSIBILITY: Centrifuge authorization, revocation and history catch-up.
MODULE_CONTRACT.INVARIANT: No delivery following completed removal; no expanded visibility on reconnect.

ISSUE32_CONTRACTS_REVISION.CLASS_FUNCTION_CONTRACT_GATE: Every affected existing /v2 handler, DPoP middleware, service and repository function requires exact signature/call-site mapping and separately approved class/function delta before implementation. No speculative signatures are introduced here. Developer must not create, modify or delete tests; independent QA owns test maintenance.
ISSUE32_CONTRACTS_REVISION.GATE: Independent Engineering Orchestrator contradiction review, Project Owner approvals in GRACE order, mental scenarios and checks required; existing test suite is untouched.

ISSUE32_CLASS_FUNCTION_CONTRACTS.SCOPE: Contract delta derived from implemented /v2 handler methods; preserve function bodies and store behaviors unless specifically required for path and DPoP-only correctness. Target routes are implemented in PR #33; the separately existing /ws transport is retained. Target HTTP root /conversations does not change the separately existing /ws transport.

CLASS_CONTRACT.name: main.buildHandler
CLASS_CONTRACT.POSTCONDITION: Bind the existing issue25.HTTPHandler to /conversations and descendants with exact segment boundary checks; retain /ws WebSocket entry; do not dispatch versioned /v1 or /v2 routes.
CLASS_CONTRACT.SIDE_EFFECTS: Only HTTP routing/wiring changes, no data mutations.

CLASS_CONTRACT.name: issue25.HTTPHandler
CLASS_CONTRACT.PRECONDITION: Handler Auth and Store DB available, no query string, exactly one Authorization header with DPoP scheme and one DPoP proof header.
CLASS_CONTRACT.POSTCONDITION: ValidateCaller with RequestBinding{Method:r.Method, Target:PublicOrigin+r.URL.EscapedPath()}, derive user solely from returned caller, delegate to route25. On invalid input/auth fail without store call. Preserve no-store and nosniff headers.
CLASS_CONTRACT.FAILURE: 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE for dependencies; 400 VALIDATION_ERROR for query; 401 AUTH_INVALID for malformed credentials; validator error through existing http25Error mapping.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.name: credentials25
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.OUTPUT: Access token, proof and success flag.
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.RULE: Require exactly one Authorization header with two fields and literal DPoP scheme, and exactly one nonempty whitespace-free DPoP proof header. Reject Bearer even with a proof; no fallback.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.name: HTTPHandler.route25
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.RULE: Trim exactly /conversations with segment-boundary semantics, reject invalid UUID segments and unknown method/path combinations. Keep existing handlers; only change root path and wiring.
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.FAILURE: 404 NOT_FOUND for invalid route; 400 VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed conversation UUID.

ROUTE_CONTRACT.POSTCONDITION: Preserve JSON fields, store semantics, state mutations and response/error mappings already used by /v2.

ROUTE_CONTRACT.IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS: IMPLEMENTED_IN_PR_33: unversioned group rename handler added under /conversations.
ROUTE_CONTRACT.INPUT: JSON object with required name string, UTF-8 length at most 256 bytes; conversationId must be valid UUID.
ROUTE_CONTRACT.PRECONDITION: Session-bound DPoP authenticated caller; caller has existing Chat owner or expressly permitted admin role; target conversation is group.
ROUTE_CONTRACT.POSTCONDITION: Atomically persist group name only; retain group ID, membership, roles, messages and document metadata unchanged; return current name in JSON.
ROUTE_CONTRACT.FAILURE: Malformed input 400, unauthenticated 401, unauthorized 403, missing group 404; no partial writes.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.name: Store.RenameGroup
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.signature: RenameGroup(ctx context.Context, conversation, actor, name string) error
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.PRECONDITION: Group identity and current owner/admin authorization verified in same transaction; group name UTF-8 bytes 1..256.
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.POSTCONDITION: Update only group name; preserve all other state and rollback on error.

ROUTE_RETIREMENT_CONTRACT.RETIRED: All HTTP /v1/conversations and /v2/conversations registrations and handler reachability, including version-prefix aliases; no Bearer fallback.
ROUTE_RETIREMENT_CONTRACT.RETAINED: GET /ws WebSocket endpoint with existing DPoP OnConnecting and independent Chat subscription authorization.
ROUTE_RETIREMENT_CONTRACT.BOUNDARY: Only /conversations and descendants route to conversation HTTP handler; /conversationsXYZ must not match. Unknown old HTTP routes return 404 and must not reach legacy handlers.
ROUTE_RETIREMENT_CONTRACT.IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS: IMPLEMENTED_IN_PR_33: legacy /v1 and /v2 HTTP routing retired; /ws retained.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.name: Validator.ValidateCaller
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.signature: ValidateCaller(ctx context.Context, accessToken, proof string, binding RequestBinding) (Caller, error)
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.RULE: Keep existing UDS session verification, dpopJkt, proof signature, htm/htu/ath and replay validation. Authenticated account ID is authoritative; never treat administrativeStatus as Chat ACL.
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.FAILURE: ErrAuthInvalid, ErrProofInvalid or ErrAuthUnavailable; no Chat side effects.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.name: Validator.ValidateOnConnecting
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.signature: ValidateOnConnecting(ctx context.Context, accessToken, proof string, publicWebSocketURL string) (Caller, error)
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.RULE: Keep existing WSS-to-HTTPS GET request binding, UDS/DPoP verification per connect and separate Chat subscription authorization; remove Bearer fallback if any is discovered in its caller wiring.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.name: decode25
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.signature: decode25(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, d any) bool
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.RULE: Preserve size limits, JSON validation and failure behavior. No new parser.

FUNCTION_CONTRACT.name: http25Error
FUNCTION_CONTRACT.RULE: Preserve existing typed error-to-status mapping and non-disclosure. No error body change implied by route relocation.
